method: Targeted unit tests, actual numeric-grid sampling, Chromium/Playwright checks and local release-integrity checks. Original model/terrain inputs are unchanged.

checks.observed: Selecting time-margin overlay before Review shows a visible calculation-required notice, names the optical base, and does not show a result legend.
After the nominal practice calculation the notice disappears, the field legend appears, and 178629 canvas pixels meet an independent green-overlay criterion.
Changing extra observation duration shows a Recalculate notice, hides the field legend and disables saving until recalculation or explicit restoration.
Practice margin remains 61.91699854342489 min; adding 63 min gives -1.0830014565751185 min, with original 20-minute reserve and cached search retained.
489376 of 490000 interior pixels met the color-spread criterion; channel range 23-255. Elevation is rendered from numeric grid values, not inferred from optical or grayscale pixels.
An independent loop over rows 50-124 and intersecting columns 2-77 gives -2705.099 to -2654.322 m, matching the displayed -2705.1 to -2654.3 m legend.
Whole-area legend changes to -2705.9 to -2285.1 m and focused legend returns when refocused. Display rescaling does not alter model elevations.

The layer states native 100 m spacing, about 379 m view width and 3.8 native pixel widths, retains coarse grayscale blocks, and labels 0-255 DN as relative display codes, not temperature or calibrated physical thermal inertia.

checks.check: Map semantics retained in text and JSON
checks.observed: Actual generated Blob text/JSON include mapDisplay, visible elevation range or DN units, qualitative limitations, app 1.1.1, original/revised plan and unchanged reserve.
The mission brief contains the visible-view contrast explanation and displayed elevation legend during print-media emulation.
At actual 390 x 844 CSS viewport, document width is 375 px without horizontal overflow; elevation legend remains visible.
Original A at the 20-degree limit still returns NO_MODELED_ROUTE with null time, while the map legend remains inspectable.

At /nested/homebound/, elevation and pending/current time-margin states work and nominal margin is 61.92 min. Content-version query keys apply to CSS, modules, worker and JSON requests to avoid mixing cached releases.

79 unit tests and the application integration audit pass. Original engine and ten prepared web files are protected by recorded hashes; app 1.1.0 and register 1.1 were archived before updating active deliverables.

limitations: The 26 application-browser scenarios from release 1.1.0 are retained as historical regression evidence; this file records the targeted checks executed for 1.1.1, not a fictional rerun of every earlier browser scenario.
No new human usability study, physical route validation, thermal calibration, astronaut-performance calibration or safety certification is asserted.
The user-facing local server on port 4180 stays running. The separate subfolder helper was stopped after testing.
The integrated browser cached older modules/configuration during initial checks. Content-versioned deployment URLs resolved the mismatch without changing or disabling scientific validation.
Native PDF/save dialogs and actual Rumahweb account deployment remain post-upload checks.
